exposure: Maternal age (under 18 years vs. over 18 years)
cohort: Participants included 39 teenage patients (under 18 years at delivery) from a Gynecology Clinic in Cluj-Napoca between 2012-2015, whose data were compared with patients over 18 years delivering during the same period.
finding: The study found that while fetal weights and gestational age at birth were lower in primiparous adolescents, there were no significant differences in the route of delivery, duration of expulsion/delivrence, or Apgar score at one minute compared to older patients, concluding that vaginal birth is a safe alternative for adolescents.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in the route of delivery between teenage patients and older patients, suggesting vaginal birth is a safe alternative for adolescents.
